# netboxplugins_dataflows_flow (Data Source)

Reads one NetBox Data Flows flow.

Plugin: `netbox-data-flows` (experimental). API: `/api/plugins/data-flows/dataflows/`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netboxplugins_dataflows_flow" "by_id" {
  id = 42
}

data "netboxplugins_dataflows_flow" "by_filter" {
  filters = { name = "example" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) NetBox query parameters on `/api/plugins/data-flows/dataflows/` that select exactly one object, for example `{ name = "example" }`.
- `id` (Number) NetBox ID of the object. Set either `id` or `filters`.

### Read-Only

- `application` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values as strings; lists and objects as JSON (`jsonencode`).
- `description` (String)
- `destination_ports` (Set of Number)
- `destinations` (Set of Number) NetBox IDs of the referenced objects.
- `group` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `inherited_status` (String)
- `inherited_tags` (Set of String) Tag names.
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `protocol` (String) One of `any`, `icmp`, `icmpv6`, `tcp`, `udp`, `tcp+udp`, `sctp`.
- `source_ports` (Set of Number)
- `sources` (Set of Number) NetBox IDs of the referenced objects.
- `status` (String) One of `enabled`, `disabled`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tag names.
- `tenant` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
